rules.rule: Preserve typed, validated, deterministic boundaries. Never allow model output or untrusted external data to directly authorize or execute control, power, Git, deployment, or messaging side effects.
Authentication, owner identity, signatures, repository identity, handoff integrity, and result validation must fail closed without leaking credentials or unredacted provider data.
Every retryable external side effect must have durable idempotency or reconciliation. Do not blindly retry an operation whose outcome may already have committed.
Repository automation and workers must not push, open or merge pull requests, deploy, bypass permissions, or broaden their authority unless an explicit typed workflow grants that exact action.
